law: Canonical LIFEPUNCH™ public package names. Source of truth for publish branches, portal listings, ChatGPT briefs, and target s&box identifiers. Proprietary headers and ownership wording apply to every package whether or not it is public yet.

naming.sboxSuffix: packageSlug with leading lifepunch removed (e.g. lifepunchbitcoin → bitcoin)
naming.repoIdent: legacy monorepo folder name until path migration — see repoIdent column

publicBranchTarget: Each packageSlug is the intended public/publish branch name on LIFEPUNCH™
